summary: VeriSign Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on June 18, 2026, for an offering of senior notes due 20__, with the principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date to be determined. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing and future unsecured debt, not guaranteed by subsidiaries, and not listed on any exchange. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and US Bancorp. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary debt financing without any change of control, restructuring, or special event.
